name: TofsDevOps
what: Your personal DevOps in Telegram: uptime, SSL, DNS, broken links, search and AI-assistant visibility. Fixes what it can and stays quiet while everything is fine.
for: Owners of small sites and pet projects without a DevOps person

name: Found You
what: Shows what a photo gives away before you post it — EXIF, GPS, place context — and makes a clean copy. The photo never leaves your browser.

name: Fingerprint
what: Shows what any website learns about you the moment you open it, how unique your browser is, and how to hide.
for: People who want to see how they are tracked

name: Good Pass
what: Explains password strength: entropy, crack time, a k-anonymous breach check, a generator and a memory trainer.
for: Anyone who wants better passwords without a lecture

name: Social Tracker Bot
what: Telegram bot that tracks followers on Telegram, YouTube and LinkedIn: weekly reports, trends, forecasts and alerts.
for: Creators and professionals growing an audience

name: morgunov.tech
what: My site: zero-build pages, an edge CMS on Cloudflare Pages, KV and R2, and the design system the other projects share.
for: People who want to know who I am or work with me

name: Lenses
what: CLI that audits a person's public digital footprint through six perception lenses.
for: People checking how they look online

name: LatteDrop
what: Beat-accurate music visualizer for macOS in the spirit of MilkDrop. Specification stage.
for: Me — a personal tool, built in the open
